assignment_algorithm.identity: group_digest = SHA-256(canonical UTF-8 JSON of {source_id, canonical_group_key, source_revision})
assignment_algorithm.canonical_json: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8; no whitespace normalization after canonicalization
assignment_algorithm.bucket: integer value of the first 8 hexadecimal digest characters modulo 20
assignment_algorithm.retry_policy: No alternate seed, bucket map, or post-hoc reassignment is permitted when a candidate split is inconvenient. A failed minimum-count or coverage check blocks release and requires a new protocol version.
assignment_algorithm.materialization: Compute and persist group_digest, bucket, assigned_partition, and contract SHA-256 before any detector fitting.
assignment_algorithm.group_key_canonicalization: Each source-specific key is serialized as an ordered JSON array of canonical scalar values; Unicode NFC and UTF-8 are applied, and no raw identifier is passed to the model.

whole bounded host/day/run/window group; red-team overlap and benign background in one selected window stay together

formal_test.membership: FA1B2de: all 53 playbooks and 1796 raw actions

minimum_release_checks.required_event_coverage: Each train/validation/calibration partition must contain process, file, and socket records, or explicit zero/unknown counters with no silent omission.
minimum_release_checks.class_balance_policy: Do not synthesize or relabel groups to satisfy counts. If a minimum fails, mark the corpus blocked and request a source/subset change.

exclusion_rules: Any FA1B2de playbook, raw action, label, outcome, or derived graph is excluded from every R5 partition.
A host/run/scenario group with uncertain authorization or incomplete provenance is quarantined.
An event crossing a selected time-window boundary is assigned to the containing group only; overlapping windows are disallowed.
Stage A smoke traces, R4 golden fixtures, packaged Sample tensors, and Track O evaluation metadata are excluded from Track-L fitting and calibration.
No group may be reassigned after validation or calibration metrics are observed.
